jobs.occupation: La Lorraine Bakery Group - Information & Knowledge Architect
jobs.description:
At Llbg, we believe that high-quality information is the foundation of better decisions, efficient collaboration, and successful AI adoption. As our Information & Knowledge Architect, you will define how information is structured, governed, and managed across the organization.

You will create the frameworks, standards, and governance models that transform data and content into trusted business knowledge. Working closely with architects, platform owners, and business stakeholders, you will ensure that information is accessible, reliable, compliant, and ready to power future AI-driven solutions. This is a strategic, hands-on role where architecture, governance, technology, and change management come together.
Function

• You define and own Llbg's information and knowledge architecture, including domain models, business glossaries, taxonomies, metadata standards, and semantic frameworks that create a shared understanding across systems, countries, and teams.

• You establish and drive our information governance framework, ensuring clear ownership, stewardship, quality standards, classification, retention, and lifecycle management for both structured and unstructured information.

• You lead master data governance by defining business object ownership, stewardship responsibilities, standards, and governance processes together with key stakeholders.

• You define how information is created, tagged, classified, versioned, stored, and retired, ensuring that content remains trusted, compliant, and ready to support AI-driven use cases.

• You collaborate closely with architects and platform owners to design and implement information models within governance and Microsoft 365 platforms.

• You establish the governance principles and guardrails for AI access to enterprise knowledge, ensuring compliance with GDPR, the EU AI Act, and internal policies.

• You lead by building. For the first AI Knowledge use cases, you are directly involved in the design and delivery, shaping the content model, retrieval logic, grounding approach, evaluation framework, and adoption journey. By leading these initial implementations, you establish the standards, best practices, and reusable templates that future teams can build upon rather than reinvent

• You engage with business stakeholders across the organization to identify, prioritize, and deliver knowledge management and AI-related initiatives that support Llbg's digital transformation journey.

• You lead and coach the AI Knowledge Engineer while driving adoption, change management, and knowledge stewardship across multiple countries and business domains.

• You hold a Master's degree in Information Science, Data Management, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a related field.

• You bring 8-12 years of experience combining information governance, data governance, and hands-on technical implementation.

• You have successfully designed and implemented taxonomies, metadata models, semantic structures, or governance frameworks that delivered measurable business value.

• You have experience with master data governance in ERP-driven environments; SAP experience is a strong advantage.

• You have the practical capability to build knowledge AI solutions yourself, from preparing and structuring source content to designing enterprise search and RAG-based experiences.

• You understand the technical and operational work behind successful AI adoption, including metadata, retrieval quality, access controls, testing, user feedback, and long-term ownership

• You are familiar with governance and catalog solutions such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, Unity Catalog, or similar platforms, and communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a strong asset.

Internship description:

What we offer:   

• Experience at a global leader. AB InBev is the world's largest brewer, and you'll get to work on impactful projects in a fast-paced environment.   
• Growth opportunities. This is more than just an internship¿it's a chance to start your career with us. Outstanding interns will be considered for full-time roles post-graduation.   
• A dynamic, fun workplace. Join a team that values collaboration, innovation, and a shared love of our iconic brands.  
Why build your career with us:  

We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities.   
   

UNIQUE CULTURE

BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES

jobs.occupation: Graduate Management Traineeship Programme (GMT) - Belgium M/W/X
jobs.description:
#Talent 

 

Launch Your Career with AB InBev: Graduate Management Trainee Program 

 

What is it? 

 

Our Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) programme is a  

• 10 months program starting in August 2027 
• 3-4-month rotations within the program 
• As a junior talent, you will work on real business projects situated in Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics 
• You will have a 70-20-10 learning and development approach, where 70% Learning on the Job, 20% Exposure to Other, 10% Formal Learning & Training 
 

Who are we looking for? 

 

You are willing to become a future leader within AB InBev, and should be comfortable with an ambiguous career track, and expect geographic mobility. 
The following qualities describe you: Leader. Proud Owner. Agile Learner. Collaborator. Future Maker. 

 
To be eligible: 

• You must have graduated (before September 2027 and no more than two years prior) with a Bachelor's, Master's (or equivalent) degree. 
• You should also have no more than 2 years of professional experience (internships/volunteers/student jobs not included). 
• Your passion and ownership are more important than the subject you studied. 
• Fluent English is needed, as well as the native language of the country you are applying in. 
• A valid permanent visa/work permit is required in the country of application to be eligible for the programme. 
• During the 10-month program and beyond, you might be required to travel within your country of application and across Europe. 
 

We are looking for: Junior talent. Recent Graduate. Junior Manager. Professional Trainee. Graduate Trainee. 
 
How can you apply? 

 

• Before you apply, check more information https://europecareers.ab-inbev.com/programmes/graduate-management-traineeship  
• Please be advised that you will only be considered for the first application you submit, therefore please make sure you are completely happy with your choice as this decision is final. 
• There is no need to upload a cover letter - this will not affect your application. 
 

Good to know 

 

• Our Graduate Management Trainee Programme is the first step to an amazing career at AB InBev. 
• Post-Programme, you will pursue a rewarding career, often within our core functions at the heart of our business within Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics. 
• GMT programme will give you valuable exposure and insights into leading and transforming a successful global business. You will work on real projects with senior stakeholders to drive value and undertake a structured program to support your development as a future leader.

Next to a competitive base salary, we put our people first by providing additional benefits:

• A unique Parental leave

• Competitive Life insurance, disability & medical plan 
• A Flexible Rewards system - (smartphone, bike lease, Extra pension Plan, etc.) 
 

Where? 
  

The GMT programme is available in: 
 
¿    Belgium

¿    Germany

With approximately 1,500 employees across Europe and nearly 500 employees based at its Belgian headquarters, the company continues to invest heavily in technology, innovation and international expansion. The legal department consists of a close-knit team of legal and regulatory specialists working collaboratively across several areas, including regulatory affairs, corporate law, commercial contracts, public affairs and employment law. The company culture is entrepreneurial, dynamic and project-driven. Employees benefit from direct access to decision-makers, significant ownership of their responsibilities and the opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives with tangible business impact.

• Managing license maintenance, renewals and related regulatory obligations

• Monitoring regulatory developments and assessing their impact on business activities
• Translating regulatory requirements into practical internal processes, controls and guidelines

• Collaborating with stakeholders across multiple countries and business functions

• Experience with Dutch law is essential

• Fluent Dutch and English, both written and spoken
• French is considered a strong asset
• Strong interest in regulatory and compliance matters
• Ability to analyse complex legal situations and provide pragmatic solutions
• Autonomous while maintaining a collaborative mindset
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving and evolving environment
• Willingness to travel occasionally to the Netherlands when required
• Good command of Microsoft Office tools and digital collaboration platforms

Personality-wise, our client is looking for someone who is transparent, approachable and communicative. The ideal candidate is comfortable acknowledging mistakes, seeks continuous improvement and enjoys working closely with colleagues in a relatively young and dynamic team environment.

jobs.description:
Our client, a leading player in the banking sector, is seeking a Cyber Security Program Manager to drive their bank-wide cyber security strategy, with a specific focus on post-quantum cryptography and long-term cryptographic resilience. You will join our client's team as a strategic leader, defining and overseeing a high-impact portfolio of security initiatives, engaging senior stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with evolving regulations and cryptographic standards.
Interested?

If you are ready to shape the future of cyber security in banking and lead our client's transition to quantum-safe architectures, we would be pleased to receive your application.

• Cyber Security Strategy & Portfolio Management - Define the cyber security initiative strategy, translate it into a prioritized portfolio, and oversee cross-dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes

• Roadmap Development & Execution - Develop long-term and short/medium-term roadmaps with clear priorities and budgets, then drive day-to-day delivery, removing impediments and ensuring adherence to master plans

• Post-Quantum Cryptography (Pqc) Knowledge - Apply strong Pqc fundamentals (e.g., lattice-based algorithms, hybrid encryption, NIST standardization) to guide cryptographic modernization and resilience

• Information Security Governance - Lead initiatives aligned with established security frameworks and risk management practices, ensuring compliance with group standards and external guidelines

• Stakeholder & Executive Engagement - Interact regularly with senior management and ExCo, aggregating input and translating complex topics like quantum risk and Pqc transition into clear, actionable memos

• Governance & Policy Contribution - Support policy improvements and the development of quantum-safe data security frameworks in collaboration with relevant teams

• Leadership & Communication - Drive success across disciplines, navigate technical uncertainty, and tailor messaging for both executives and technical teams

• Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills - Break down complex issues such as Pqc migration trade-offs, proactively addressing long-term cryptographic risks and immediate vulnerabilities

• Language Skills - French mandatory (fluent), with professional proficiency in English and Dutch

• Work Arrangement - Hybrid working model based in Brussels
